newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Rayon Ind rises on new projects.
newsitem.headline: Indian Rayon Ind rises on new projects.

text.p: Shares of Indian Rayon Industries rose on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday on the eve of the firm's expected commissioning of new projects, brokers said.
The share rose 14.75 rupees or 6.08 percent to 257.50 rupees in late morning trade.
"Their sea-water magnesia project is about to be commissioned," said a analyst at a Bombay brokerage. "That could be driving the share," he said.
Magnesia is one of the three new projects expected to be commissioned in this financial year.
Indian Rayon's main business of viscose filament yarn was also doing well, driven by good demand from the rayon tyre cord industry, dealers said.
A dealer at a European brokerage said Monday's price rise was a correction. "The share fell by about 20 percent last month," he said. "There was reason for it to fall," he said.
